GL.jql: project in (GL) AND issuetype in (Enhancement, Epic) AND fixVersion in (Blank, UnPlanned, N2027.R1, N2026.R2) ORDER BY "Scope Commitment At SC", status desc, Priority DESC

FAA.jql: project in (FAA) AND issuetype in (Enhancement, Epic) AND fixVersion in (Blank, UnPlanned, N2027.R1, N2026.R2) ORDER BY "Scope Commitment At SC" asc, status desc, Priority DESC

FCO.jql: project in (FCO) AND issuetype in (Enhancement, Epic) AND fixVersion in (Blank, UnPlanned, N2027.R1, N2026.R2) ORDER BY "Scope Commitment At SC", status DESC, Priority DESC

INC.jql: project in (INC) AND issuetype in (Enhancement, Epic) AND fixVersion in (Blank, UnPlanned, N2027.R1, N2026.R2) ORDER BY "Scope Commitment At SC", status DESC, Priority DESC

NFS.jql: project in (NFS) AND issuetype in (Enhancement, Epic) AND fixVersion in (Blank, UnPlanned, N2027.R1, N2026.R2) ORDER BY "Scope Commitment At SC", status DESC, Priority DESC

P2P.jql: project in (P2P) AND issuetype in (Enhancement) AND fixVersion in (Blank, UnPlanned, N2027.R1, N2026.R2) ORDER BY "Scope Commitment At SC", status desc, Priority DESC

BUGS.jql: project in (NFS, GL, FCO, FAA, INC, P2P) AND issuetype = Bug AND fixVersion in (Blank, UnPlanned, N2027.R1, N2026.R2) ORDER BY priority DESC, created DESC

PEGL.jql: project in (NFS, GL, FCO, FAA, INC, P2P) AND issuetype = "R&D Pre-GoLive Bug" AND fixVersion in (Blank, UnPlanned, N2027.R1, N2026.R2) ORDER BY priority DESC, created DESC

POGL.jql: project in (NFS, GL, FCO, FAA, INC, P2P) AND issuetype = "R&D Post-GoLive Bug" AND fixVersion in (Blank, UnPlanned, N2027.R1, N2026.R2) ORDER BY priority DESC, created DESC
